comments.text: 2026-10-30 Pages implemented behind infra/cli-sign-in.json (disabled) in draft PR #93: cli/src/prospectus_cli/pages.py with 26 specs against an in-process broker. Open: the /cli rewrite on prospectus.anth.us (infra/hosting-settings.json is not applied by the pipeline).

comments.text: Ryan chose to apply the /cli rewrite from CDK.
